paper_metadata.title: NExT-GPT: Any-to-Any Multimodal LLM
paper_metadata.abstract: While recently Multimodal Large Language Models (MM-LLMs) have made exciting strides, they mostly fall prey to the limitation of only input-side multimodal understanding, without the ability to produce content in multiple modalities. As we humans always perceive the world and communicate with people through various modalities, developing any-to-any MM-LLMs capable of accepting and delivering content in any modality becomes essential to human-level AI. To fill the gap, we present an end-to-end general-purpose any-to-any MM-LLM system, NExT-GPT. We connect an LLM with multimodal adaptors and different diffusion decoders, enabling NExT-GPT to perceive inputs and generate outputs in arbitrary combinations of text, images, videos, and audio. By leveraging the existing well-trained highly-performing encoders and decoders, NExT-GPT is tuned with only a small amount of parameter (1%) of certain projection layers, which not only benefits low-cost training and also facilitates convenient expansion to more potential modalities. Moreover, we introduce a modality-switching instruction tuning (MosIT) and manually curate a high-quality dataset for MosIT, based on which NExT-GPT is empowered with complex cross-modal semantic understanding and content generation. Overall, our research showcases the promising possibility of building an AI agent capable of modeling universal modalities, paving the way for more human-like AI research in the community. Project page: https://next-gpt.github.io/

extraction_data.innovation: End-to-end any-to-any multimodal LLM system: connects an LLM with multimodal adaptors and different diffusion decoders to accept and deliver content in arbitrary combinations of text, image, video, and audio, overcoming prior limitations of input-side-only understanding or interleaved text-image generation; Modality-Switching Instruction Tuning (MosIT): manually curated high-quality dataset enabling complex cross-modal semantic understanding and content generation, allowing low-cost training (1% of projection layer parameters) and convenient expansion to new modalities without cascading discrete text noise.
extraction_data.pretraining_task: Instruction following, multimodal understanding and generation
extraction_data.finetuning_task: Modality-switching instruction tuning (MosIT), Multimodal instruction tuning
extraction_data.extension: LoRA adapters for LLM, projection layers for encoders/decoders
extraction_data.research_problem: Any-to-any multimodal language understanding and generation
extraction_data.application: Image captioning, image question answering, video reasoning, audio captioning, text-to-image/audio/video generation
extraction_data.finetuning_data: MosIT dataset (5,000 high-quality samples), CC3M, WebVid, AudioCaps, MosIT Dataset
extraction_data.tokenizer: Unified tokenizer (shared vocabulary across text, image, video, audio)
extraction_data.training_pipeline: End-to-end tuning of projection layers (1% of parameters) connecting pre-trained encoders/decoders to an LLM
extraction_data.fusion_architecture: LLM-centric with multimodal adaptors and diffusion decoders
extraction_data.base_model: Pre-trained LLM (e.g., LLaMA, Flan-T5), CLIP, ImageBind, latent diffusion models
